entries.speaker: Well-Behaved Student
entries.en: Being super late on his first day? He really[n]is insane...

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: He looks normal though...

entries.speaker: Gaudy Male Student
entries.en: But he might slug us if we look him in[n]the eye...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Settle down.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Well, I'd like to introduce a transfer[n]student: [f 4 3].

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Today, we... had him attend from the[n]afternoon on since he wasn't feeling well.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: All right, please say something to[n]the class.
Nice to meet you.

entries.speaker: Prim Female Student
entries.en: He seems quiet... but I bet when he[n]loses it...

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: I mean, he was arrested for[n]assault, right?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Uhh, so...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Your seat will be... Hmm...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Over there. The one that's open.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Sorry, but can the people nearby please[n]share your textbooks with him for today?

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: This sucks...

entries.speaker: Flashy Student
entries.en: ...Lies.
Huh?
You're that girl...

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: ...Did you catch that? Do those two know[n]each other?

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: Eww... Does that mean he hit on her[n]before transferring here?

entries.speaker: Prim Female Student
entries.en: That means she's cheating on him with[n]Mr. Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Prim Female Student
entries.en: Then again, this is Takamaki-san we're[n]talking about...

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: For real. That side of the room is totally[n]awful.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Oh, right! The volleyball rally's in[n]two days...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Everyone's just changed classes, so make[n]sure you use that time to get to know each[n]other.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Well then, let's get class started.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Who's on duty today?

entries.speaker: Well-Behaved Student
entries.en: Everyone, please rise...
